statements.select: select upper(replace(O.NAME,'_','')) as TABLENAME, upper(replace(C.NAME,'_','')) as COLUMNNAME, T.NAME as TYPENAME,C.PREC as LENGTH,C.ISNULLABLE from sysobjects O left join syscolumns C on O.ID=C.ID left join systypes T on C.XTYPE=T.XTYPE where 1=1 and T.NAME in ('char','nchar','varchar','nvarchar') and O.NAME not like '%sys%' and O.NAME not like '%tracking%' and O.NAME not like '%bulktype%' and C.NAME not like '%@%'

select O.NAME as TABLENAME,C.NAME as COLUMNNAME,T.NAME as TYPENAME,C.LENGTH,C.ISNULLABLE from sysobjects O left join syscolumns C on O.ID=C.ID left join systypes T on C.XTYPE=T.XTYPE where upper(replace(O.NAME,'_','')) = upper(#TableName#) and upper(replace(C.NAME,'_','')) = upper(#ColumnName#) and T.NAME in ('char','varchar','nvarchar')
